lines.text: During a famine, Isaac went to Gerar, and the LORD told him not to go down to Egypt.
Isaac told the men of Gerar that Rebekah was his sister, because he feared they would kill him.
Isaac reaped a hundredfold, and the Philistines, who envied him, filled his father's wells with stones.
Isaac named the first quarreled-over well Esek, and the well nobody quarreled over Rehoboth.
When Esau was forty, he married Judith and Basemath, two Hivite women who brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
